creatures.name: Swarm, Crab
creatures.immune: mind-affecting effects, swarm traits, weapon damage
creatures.description: A writhing mass of clacking shells and snapping pincers rushes from the surf, their spider-like legs twitching across the sand.
creatures.ecology: Crab swarms contain over a thousand normal-sized crabs that rush over their victims, plucking flesh with thousands of pinching claws. Some fishermen claim tides and phases of the moon cause these creatures to swarm as they do.

creatures.name: Swarm, Leech
creatures.immune: mind-affecting effects, swarm traits, weapon damage
creatures.racial_modifiers: +8 Stealth in swamps, uses Dexterity to modify Swim checks
creatures.description: A mass of wriggling black creatures each the size of a man's finger stirs the stagnant water before enveloping its victim.

special_abilities.name: Blood Drain
special_abilities.description: Any living creature that begins its turn with a leech swarm in its space is drained of its blood and takes 1d3 points of Str and Con damage.

creatures.ecology: This horrifying cloud of ravenous, blood-draining parasites eschews the stealth of a lone leech's methods in favor of swift and merciless feeding.

creatures.name: Swarm, Rat
creatures.racial_modifiers: uses Dex to modify Climb and Swim
creatures.organization: solitary, pack (2-5 swarms), or infestation (6-12 swarms)
creatures.description: A squirming, roiling mass of squeaking rats draws closer, teeth flashing and claws scratching everything in its path.

special_abilities.name: Disease
special_abilities.description: The save DC is Constitution-based. Swarm:

creatures.ecology:
A rat swarm typically consists of a biting, roiling mass of hundreds of disease-ridden rats driven to uncharacteristic heights of aggression by fantastic and overwhelming hunger. In such numbers, they become voracious hunters, capable of killing a full-grown human with hundreds of bites. Rat swarms are often found in the sewers of large human settlements.

Rat swarms surround and attack any warm-blooded prey in their path.

creatures.name: Swarm, Spider
creatures.racial_modifiers: +4 Perception; uses Dexterity for Climb checks
creatures.organization: solitary, pair, tangle (3-6 swarms) or colony (11-20 swarms)
creatures.description: An awful, scuttling mass of legs and mandibles scrambles forward out of the darkness.

special_abilities.name: Poison
special_abilities.description: The save DC is Constitution-based. Swarm:

creatures.ecology: The sight of a carpet of swarming spiders is unsettling indeed—particularly when the swarm is made up of spiders each the size of a gold coin and possessing blade-like mandibles capable of lacerating flesh with sickening ease. A swarm of spiders is a colonial mass of arachnids that relies on overwhelming much larger prey with sheer numbers rather than catching smaller snacks. While spider swarms spin webs, these webs are incapable of catching larger prey and typically serve the swarm as a lair rather than a method of capturing dinner.

creatures.name: Swarm, Wasp
creatures.organization: solitary, pair, fury (3-6 swarms), maelstrom (7-12 swarms)
creatures.description: A low, ominous buzz announces the arrival of a mass of many thousands of angry, stinging wasps.

special_abilities.name: Poison
special_abilities.description: The save DC is Constitution-based. Swarm:

creatures.ecology:
A wasp swarm is a flying mass of thousands of carnivorous wasps. In such large numbers, they become voracious hunters, capable of taking down large creatures with their venom-filled stings. While a wasp swarm is capable of inflicting hundreds of stings, its true danger arises from its insatiable appetite for meat.

Wasp swarms surround and attack any living prey in their paths, and are swift to seek out new prey once their anger is aroused. An enraged wasp swarm often loses track of its hive or the original source of its anger, and presented with a constant series of new targets to swarm and sting, a swarm can continue its rampage nonstop until it is destroyed or dispersed.
